purpose: Quantify which qualitative island-response states are generated in already-frozen ABM experiments, which tested mechanism axes distinguish them, and which observations count as model misses or protected falsifications without adding field-data requirements.
region_definition: A state region is a finite, already-tested ABM factor/configuration region. It is not a claim about the full continuous parameter space.

state_rules.branches_downstream: A matched run contains at least one positive and one negative lineage reproductive response under the same upstream island contrast.
state_rules.same_direction_response: A matched run is non-mixed: all nonzero lineage reproductive responses have the same sign.
state_rules.strong_buffering: A lineage that declines when local support is off becomes nonnegative when the tested support/network-context route is on.
state_rules.magnitude_attenuation_without_sign_rescu: A negative reproductive response becomes less negative under a tested route but remains negative.
state_rules.branch_reallocation: A lineage response sign changes when one tested mechanism factor is toggled in a paired synthetic contrast.
state_rules.reproductive_axes_decouple: Empirical constraint only; not assigned a synthetic generator from the current frozen ABM.
state_rules.counterdirectional_prediction: Protected empirical falsification of a frozen mapping; not treated as a state the ABM should tune itself to reproduce.

identifiability_rule: Synthetic mechanism identifiability is assessed only within the declared ABM and tested ablations. Real-world mechanism identification is not inferred from qualitative state compatibility.
external_challenge_rule: The 13 strict island systems are qualitative held-out state challenges. Their literature-derived state labels may test state-space coverage without supplying numerical calibration targets.
falsification_rules: If initial trait heterogeneity is removed in the frozen v12 residual gate and within-run mixed-sign branching persists, the minimal-generator claim is falsified.
If an external strict target is outside every frozen synthetic state class, record a state-space miss rather than adding or tuning a mechanism post hoc.
Dominica remains a protected failure of the frozen signed-position mapping and must not be retuned away.
Network context must not be called a universal buffer because the frozen robustness block contains both sign rescues and worsenings.
Autonomous assurance must not be called a robust strong sign buffer because independent and broadened frozen blocks contain zero sign rescues.
